text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—The Derby is finally here!! Blow away all 
the jinxes and common sense, and win it in 
flashy style, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Today, I don't wanna see Mr. C.B. do 
anything other than win...! Go for it~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...The excitement is incredible. I wonder 
if Ace-chan is alright.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Es-cchi, playing away from 
home is no problem! You fought so coolly 
in the Satsuki Sho, after all. You'll 
definitely crush the Derby too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Awaiting the start of the race, 
Katsuragi Ace showed a tension unlike 
anything seen before.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. How should I put it... I can't 
seem to shake this restless feeling. My 
body feels kinda heavy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...How pathetic. Even though just a moment 
ago, I talked big and said, 'Shaking or 
scared, all you gotta do is overcome it'—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Even now, the image of CB in the Satsuki 
Sho remains burned into my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that overwhelming feeling I got 
from her back then—something like an 
instinct inside me has been raging 
nonstop...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...! How am I ever gonna surpass 
her at this rate...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I send Katsuragi Ace out like this, 
it's obvious she won't be able to display 
her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is there something I can say to encourage 
her?" With that thought, I reflected on 
the days I'd spent with Katsuragi Ace, and 
the words that came to mind were――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh— What's up with you all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: ...I realized I never properly said it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Up until today, Katsuragi Ace has kept 
running forward without looking aside, 
aiming to become an 'Ace.'”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through sheer willpower and hard work, she 
had overtaken countless others blessed 
with better environments and superior 
talent—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And at last, she had reached the point 
where she could challenge the pinnacle 
race, on a stage once deemed a "different 
world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if the world's attention is focused 
on Mr. C.B., she remains at the very top 
of her generation right now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming alone from the countryside to pass 
through Tracen Academy's gates and 
reaching these heights—her hoofprints are 
something to be celebrated...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...So, congratulations?
choice_data_list:
It's the Derby you seized with your own 
strength.
You won this Derby with your own strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing reality and continuing to fight 
forward anyway. As a Trainer, I'd like to 
think I understand just how difficult and 
noble that truly is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can do it. And because she can, she's 
standing here today. I believe in 
Katsuragi Ace's strength, as proven by 
that fact.
choice_data_list:
To me, you're an incredible Uma Musume 
too.

From my perspective, you are an 
extraordinary Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So, I want you to be confident. I want 
you to face it fearlessly, like Katsuragi 
Ace should." With these thoughts in mind, 
I clench my fist in front of her.
choice_data_list:
Believe in everything you've done so far 
and run, Ace!

Believe in everything you've done until 
now and run, Ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Everything I've done up till now—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You believe in me, don't you, Trainer? In 
everything I've done... up until now.
choice_data_list: I believe in you now, and I always will.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks a lot. It kinda cooled my head 
off, y'know... Like everything's clear 
again.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I think I was focusing too much on C.B., 
so I ended up shrinking back all on my 
own..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...'Believe in everything you've done so 
far', huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's awesome...! I can feel 
something welling up big time...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Even if my heart is stirred up, as long 
as I have these words, as long as 
something inside me wells up, I know I can 
fight...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Katsuragi Ace gave a 
grin and raised her right hand. I matched 
her, raising my right hand too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A crisp, refreshing sound resonated, 
blowing away the oppressive gloom."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm off!! Look forward to me becoming a 
Derby Umamusume!
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting in the winner's circle!!

I'll be waiting for you in the winner's 
circle!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looking good.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What is this intimidating aura...?! I can 
barely breathe...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.... I really can't take my eyes 
off her...

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. Even though I know I shouldn't 
hesitate...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Cee Beeeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Here comes the second set!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Shall we do round two? The Nippon 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Ace-san... Do you truly feel no fear at 
all...?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it. Even while feeling 
fear, she still did it...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hit 'em— with everything I've 
got!
